name: io.github.imharikumaran/altimateguide
description: Submit a tool to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review, add a time-boxed deal (lifetime deal, sale, or launch offer), and upgrade the listing to dofollow. The paid listing is the fastest route (one-time fee, reviewed within 2 business days, nothing to install); free SayAbout.Us wall and badge paths are also available. Free no-verification listings stay nofollow.

environmentVariables.name: ALTIMATEGUIDE_AGENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional account API token. Create one at https://altimateguide.com/account (Agent & API access), or mint one at runtime with the complete_login tool (email OTP).
